description: Pake-built Excalidraw web app packaged as a lightweight Windows desktop wrapper.

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Pake Excalidraw MSI not found: $msi" }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "Pake Excalidraw MSI installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Pake Excalidraw MSI not found: $msi. Refusing to remove Scoop files while Windows Installer registration may remain." }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "Pake Excalidraw MSI uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

notes: This is the Pake-built Excalidraw web wrapper, not the service provider's native Windows client. Its official MSI is per-machine and requires administrator approval. Scoop sets INSTALLDIR so the application files stay in this Scoop version directory; Windows Installer owns the application registration and Start Menu/Desktop shortcuts. Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Windows Installer exit code 3010 means a reboot is required; Scoop does not restart Windows automatically.
